name: David McAllister - Après le § 15 - Am 14
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 15f. Expresses deep concern about the impact of the reactivation of sanctions against Iran on the Iranian people; stresses that such measures primarily affect the civilian population, further exacerbating economic hardship, including medicine shortages, which constitute a violation of human rights, and have fostered the increased militarisation of Iranian society;
